Package org.keycloak.connections.jpa

Class AsyncCommitIntegrator

java.lang.Object
org.keycloak.connections.jpa.AsyncCommitIntegrator
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.hibernate.event.spi.PreDeleteEventListener, org.hibernate.event.spi.PreInsertEventListener, org.hibernate.event.spi.PreUpdateEventListener
public abstract class AsyncCommitIntegrator extends Object implements org.hibernate.event.spi.PreInsertEventListener, org.hibernate.event.spi.PreUpdateEventListener, org.hibernate.event.spi.PreDeleteEventListener
Hibernate event listener that enables asynchronous commit for transactions that only modify entities implementing AsynchronousCommitAllowed.

Database-specific subclasses implement the actual mechanism:

  • PostgreSQLAsyncCommitIntegrator — SET LOCAL synchronous_commit TO OFF
  • MSSQLAsyncCommitIntegrator — COMMIT TRAN WITH (DELAYED_DURABILITY = ON)
  • OracleAsyncCommitIntegrator — COMMIT WRITE BATCH NOWAIT

MySQL and MariaDB are not supported: their equivalent setting innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit is session-scoped, not transaction-scoped. Setting it before commit would leave the relaxed durability on the pooled connection, silently affecting subsequent unrelated transactions if the reset fails.

On unsupported databases, registerListeners(EntityManagerFactory, boolean) is a no-op.

Author:
Alexander Schwartz

  • Method Details

    • registerListeners

      public static void registerListeners(jakarta.persistence.EntityManagerFactory emf, boolean xaEnabled)
      Registers asynchronous commit listeners on the given EntityManagerFactory if the underlying database supports it. No-op for unsupported databases.
      Parameters:
      xaEnabled - whether the datasource uses XA transactions. Implementations that issue a raw COMMIT (SQL Server, Oracle) are incompatible with XA because the XA coordinator owns the transaction boundaries.

    • supportsXa

      protected boolean supportsXa()
      Whether this implementation is compatible with XA datasources. Implementations that issue a raw COMMIT inside the managed transaction must return false — XA coordinators do not allow explicit commit on enlisted connections (Oracle raises ORA-02089, SQL Server rejects commits outside the XA coordinator).

      Defaults to true for implementations like PostgreSQL that only set session variables.

    • isEnabled

      protected abstract boolean isEnabled(org.hibernate.engine.spi.SessionFactoryImplementor sf)
      Whether asynchronous commit should be enabled for this database. Called once at startup to perform database-specific validation.

    • applyAsyncCommit

      protected abstract void applyAsyncCommit(Connection connection) throws SQLException
      Apply the database-specific mechanism to make the current transaction's commit asynchronous. Called via doWork just before Hibernate issues the JDBC commit.
      Throws:
      SQLException
